gray.

a minimal agent harness. one binary. your machine, your keys.

Install — Linux / macOS / WSL

curl -fsSL https://gray.alignment.id/install.sh | sh              # stable
curl -fsSL https://gray.alignment.id/install.sh | sh -s -- beta   # beta (every push to main)

Install — Windows (PowerShell)

iwr https://gray.alignment.id/install.ps1 -UseBasicParsing | iex

Windows runs through WSL — the script checks and guides you.

Run

gray                                  # interactive REPL — no setup forced
gray -p "explain this repo"             # one-shot (also --print)
gray -c                                 # resume last session
echo "hi" | gray -p "summarize"

First run drops you at the prompt. /provider picks a provider (free tier / API key / OAuth / local), /model picks a model. Env still works: GRAY_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GRAY_MODEL.

What it is

loopReAct tool loop — streams text, calls tools, feeds results back
toolsbash · read · write · edit · grep · find · ls
sessionsJSONL on disk (~/.gray/sessions), gray -c to resume
sizeone binary · no runtime · no node_modules
promptminimal — identity + guidelines, editable at ~/.gray/sys.md (/sys)
